annotations.title: Get details of a funding programme

description: Use this when the user wants details about one specific Canadian funding programme: what it pays for, how much, who can apply, its current intake status and the application steps. Pass the programme name or the `slug` from a search result. Do not use for: scholarships, bursaries or student aid; personal loans, debt relief, mortgages or household benefits (EI, CPP, child benefit); funding outside Canada (US, UK, EU…); writing a business plan or grant application; investment advice.

program.description: Programme slug from search_grants (preferred) or its name.

name: get_grant
